alicorn.base_commit_subject: test(webgpu): drive an active motion through induced D3D12 removal (#146 G6)
alicorn.instrumentation: uncommitted measurement-only startup markers at capture time; published in the phase-1 commit
alicorn.note: The host was not optimized. Markers, the attribution line and the PowerShell runner are the only changes.

scratchpad.workspace: generated 193-file A/B workspace (8 directories, 24 files each, 5,000-line application/sample_00.go, README.md)
scratchpad.environment: fresh APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA per launch; SCRATCHPAD_ALICORN_WORKSPACE=<generated workspace>; SCRATCHPAD_ALICORN_SMOKE removed

punks.build: cargo build -p punks-caliber --release; odin build punks-standalone/odin -collection:alicorn=<this worktree> -collection:alikit=<clone>/vendor/alicorn-kit <accesskit args> -o:speed
punks.scene: built-in smoke: open the fixture folder, select and audition the first audio file, stop, search, render the waveform, exit

host.desktop_load: other desktop applications (Discord, browsers, OpenCode) were running; CPU load recorded in summary.json

counters.gpu_sampling: every 500 ms and once at the PASS marker; summed over the process's LUID/phys instances
counters.process_sampling: every 10 ms during the launch; settle values captured when the PASS line was observed

warm_state: warm-order; one session-first launch and one unmeasured file-cache warmup per app; no reboot, cache purge or page-file control

artifacts.diagnostics: diagnostics/<app>/ (bundle JSON and window JSON; screenshot PPMs were discarded)
